method: exact-string replacement (anchor asserted to occur once), up to four runs of the card's own check per mutant, restore by writing the original bytes back and comparing sha256. A red run is credited as a kill only when the named row is red in a run whose signature repeats and no clean PASS appears.

flake_note: M-E1 run 3, R2-M1 run 3, SD1 run 1 and R2-M13b run 1 were broad-collapse FAILs (69-72 assertions, 23-26 red rows, ~70% transport details) separated from a kill only by repeating the run. My own single-run first pass misclassified R2-M12 as killed by 21 rows; the repeat gave PASS 95, so R2-M12 survives.
